SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Location, Position and Size of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Location, Position and Size of Kenya as rumours only.

   D. Say Location, Position and Size of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

   A. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Development of Transport is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Development of Transport as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   D. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about School administration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School administration.
   B. Explain School administration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat School administration as rumours only.
   D. Say School administration never happens in Kenya.

   D. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
